changelog: Stability release for any hosting setup. Frontend hooks never crash the storefront: every hook is guarded and swallowed exceptions are recorded in the admin Logs tab. Outbound HTTP uses curl with millisecond connect/total timeouts and CURLOPT_NOSIGNAL, so DNS hangs cannot freeze workers. Timeouts auto-tune to the SAPI: 3s on PHP-FPM (response already flushed via fastcgi_finish_request) and 800ms on Apache mod_php or CGI. fastcgi_finish_request is now called at most once per request via a shared flag. getCachedConfig is memoised per request so Header + Footer + checkout consent only ever trigger one config fetch (30min stale-fallback cache). cart_updated is suppressed during order validation. Every frontend hook early-returns when the plugin is not active (disconnect = zero work). Configuration reads are memoised in-process. Cookie sanitisation no longer SQL-escapes JSON values. Admin: undefined variable in the Logs tab is fixed and Clear Logs now actually clears logs. Minimum PrestaShop bumped to 1.7.4.0 (PHP 7.1+). Validator-clean.
